title: #248 Good Progress
prompt: Some researchers allege that progress is always good. Will you support this statement?

promptSegments.text: Some researchers allege that progress is always good.

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ quan điểm bằng hai lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Dùng ví dụ phù hợp khi chúng làm rõ ý.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Progress helps people live better lives by improving communication and daily tasks.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Progress helps people live better lives by improving communication and daily tasks.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Progress helps people learn new skills and improve their knowledge through modern education.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Progress helps people learn new skills and improve their knowledge through modern education.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Progress can cause problems for people, especially those who lose their jobs.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Progress can cause problems for people, especially those who lose their jobs.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Fast change can hurt the environment by using too many resources and cutting down nature.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Fast change can hurt the environment by using too many resources and cutting down nature.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Progress improves our quality of life through new inventions and medical technology, allowing people to live longer and healthier lives.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Progress improves our quality of life through new inventions and medical technology, allowing people to live longer and healthier lives.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Progress helps societies develop better systems by connecting people globally through improved communication and transport links, making knowledge sharing easier.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Progress helps societies develop better systems by connecting people globally through improved communication and transport links, making knowledge sharing easier.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Progress can increase social gaps and inequality.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Progress can increase social gaps and inequality.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Rapid change and industrial growth can harm the environment.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Rapid change and industrial growth can harm the environment.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not explain the statement without making your own position clear.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ giải thích nhận định mà quên nêu rõ quan điểm cá nhân.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?

modelPlan.focus: evaluate whether progress is always good by examining its benefits and drawbacks, using examples from technology and society.
keyArguments: Progress brings advancements in technology and infrastructure, improving quality of life.
However, rapid progress can lead to ethical dilemmas and unintended consequences, such as environmental degradation and social disparities.
